limitations: No independent per-trade USDT-loss cap or daily monetary-loss cap exists in current RiskPolicy.
Risk drawdown is closed-trade peak-to-current-equity at new-entry checks, excludes floating loss, and is scoped to one isolated run.
Risk locks reject new entries; they do not guarantee a fill price, halt the host, or cancel open-position protection.
Ordinary funding is explicitly zero-modeled and can pass current Paper assessment; it is not full realized-cost evidence.
Historical research replay does not enforce live E5 account, leverage, daily-count or position-cap mechanics.
Public acquisition range is bounded to 89 days, with at most 64 recorded requests; this 88-day plan is not a multi-regime study.
No historic date is asserted independently unobserved until all prior ledgers/evidence are reconciled.
Sampling/thresholds are a proposed protocol, not a profitability guarantee or evidence of statistical sufficiency.
No OS startup, power or security setting change is included; product scheduling runs after normal product launch.
prestart_gates: Explicit human policy/model selection; freeze chosen policy hashes before results.
Fresh owning profile; preserve immutable diagnostic selection; new store owns its actual fixed software qualification receipt.
Real keyless acquisition and exact data/funding hashes/coverage; prior-observation ledger reconciled without resetting family history.
Actual versioned engineering package through author-package/intake; requested profiles match actual manifest.
Actual development/robustness/frozen-finalist/sealed-OOS CANDIDATE with selected risk hash; never lower thresholds to force PASS.
Same-store exact native current-release admission, local owner enrollment and explicit workflow; existing formal configure commands only.
Market freshness, protection/recovery, free resources, actual capture growth/capacity and bounded stop/report assessed before initial observation.
Retention/archive and long-run behavior still require technical work before claiming unattended 30-day readiness; no silent deletion or restart for gate evasion.

After run-product starts services, authenticated UI/API PaperStart must accept the exact selected identity/policy/current revision/stable command ID; read back original accepted run_id and actual runtime owner attachment before declaring observation started. Coordinator scheduling never issues PaperStart.

proposed_engineering_input.change: Replace the literal ADX20 comparison in both directions with referenced integer parameter adx_threshold=20; remove unused fast_window. No baseline numerical change is asserted as tested.

required_human_decisions: Select or amend every proposed financial/research/forward value; this draft is not a selection.
Choose disclosed zero-funding Paper-only model versus requiring a realized-funding model before any observation.
Accept the supported exposure/closed-drawdown controls for this simulated run, or require a separate per-trade/daily monetary-loss control before entry.
